newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korea's SEC says likely to approve 10 IPOs.
newsitem.headline: South Korea's SEC says likely to approve 10 IPOs.

text.p: South Korea's Securities and Exchange Commission said it was likely to approve 10 initial public offering (IPO) applications on Thursday.

The applications were made by Hyundai Electronics Industrial Co, Samsung Engineering Co, Kukdong City Gas Co, textile wholesaler Kuk Dong Corp, chemical products producer Sewon Chemical Co, distiller Muhak Alcohol Co, chemical products producer Dong Nam Chemical Industries Co, office machinery maker Sindoricoh Co, equipment manufacturer Hankook Steel Co and furniture maker Fursys Inc, the SEC said in a statement.
The offerings, if approved, will be held on November 19 and 20 and the shares will begin publicly trading in January.
The SEC said an application from First Mutual Savings and Finance Co Ltd was still under consideration.
A meeting was scheduled for 3.00 p.m. (0600 GMT) on Thursday to make a final decision on all the applications, the statement said.
